author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a child (ring head, dress body, splayed legs) with arms out holding a rope that arches over the head; follows the reference. Compared three candidates: a stick torso with T arms read as an eye in a dome, a rope-under-feet variant read as a figure in a bowl, and this dress-body version reads best. The rejected drawing had a dot head and the rope merged into the arms.
omissions: The fists and the dress's jagged hem are simplified; head-to-shoulder gap is exactly 8 on centerlines (4 ink) per the shared human reference.
drawing_plan: VRECT_L symmetric about x 24: head r4 at (24,17); dress shoulders y 29 (x 20..28) to hem y 38 (x 16..32); arms to hands (8,32)/(40,32); legs to (19,44)/(29,44); rope bezier arch hand to hand, top y 4.
lucide_reference: No Lucide rope icon; figure from icon_set/references/human_ref/full_body_ref.png (dress figure).
